Why do you bother "Red Pilling?"

You want change. You want change that brings people in-line with your ideology. A restoration of morality, stability, and common sense, is the effort you make. You share strong, well reasoned positions based on historical facts. You create info-graphic and memes to help resonate your points, in the hopes that the message will spread. You smile when you see others mimic and repeat the information you share. Minds are changing, and perhaps the movement you spend your time supporting, will grow.

But it doesn't. It plateaus' off. Flattens. An echo chamber of 20 of your internet buddies repeating the same thing over and over, like a lawn sprinkler. So you sit back and consider new methods of spreading your message, but they plateau as well.

Why? Why have things begun to stall out? If one steps back and takes a macro view of the situation, you will notice a few important details. First, many of your movement seek an almost monk like purity, from any potential new member that you are recruiting. Even if the person signs up for and agrees with the movement because of your persuasive arguments, they are often disqualified. Why? Because they are not "pure" enough. They have committed some offense in the past that immediately, upon discovery, causes the rest of the movement to reject, belittle, harass and disassociate with that individual. They are ganged up on by a pack of almost sycophantic hyenas with blood-lust.

So, that person is gone. Others watch from the side lines and see this occurring, and decide that even though they may agree with your positions, they would much rather not get involved. So why bother red Pilling? Why bother making the effort to educate the masses and encourage them to sign up with your ideology, if they do not qualify in the first place? Are you so pure? Is ANYONE ON THIS PLANET that pure? What is the damn point?

In order for a group with uncomfortable or 'radical' ideas to grow, there must be a pathway for change. Red Pilling should allow for the addition of those that have truly changed, that have truly seen the light of your wisdom. If one has sincerely efforted toward change, why should they be rejected for a past offense, before they even came to the understanding or worldview with which you have instilled in them? Some of the greatest and most powerful movements in the world came about and grew, because they allowed for sincere change.

Now let me be clear, for the knuckle-heads that will make their 1000 assumptions. 1. This does not mean that you violate the ideology. This means that from this point forward, that potential recruit should try to live up to the standards that exist within the movement. If any member fails, then you boot them, if you wish. 2. The change by the individual has to be sincere. If you detect that the person is a fraud, then there should be no complaints with their expulsion. 3. No one is that damn pure. However, through structure provided from within the ideology, we can promote and effort change in every individual to better themselves, moving towards that level of purity. In effect, changing from what we are to what we wish to become, and bringing others along for the ride. Red Pilling should encourage sincere change and thus grow the movement. Running around like the Spanish Inquisition accomplishes nothing but the plateau effect, or even discourages others (primarily the Normies) from even considering the full ideology. It is a numbers game, and the right doesn't have it.

As far as I see, two choices exist:

  1. Continue the in-fighting, causing more and more consternation. This tactic will eventually lead to those in the middle rejecting the concepts offered all-together. or

  2. Focus on real strategies for growth, and push through to the masses.

So when you sit there in the comfort of your chair, dropping that latest info-graphic on the internet or arguing serious ideological points, ask yourself this question:

Why do you bother "Red Pilling?"
